steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop right there!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The gangsters chasing you were all taken out by us, so stop running you little brat! Come down here and thank us!!!

The young man suddenly flips up the hanging ladder and leaps onto the rooftop. He sprints across buildings, tugging on the clotheslines from time to time. It's like he's simply showing off his parkour skills.
While Hella watches in awe, the young man hits an abrupt stop... Hecate's Nightmare has destroyed his path. He seems unable to see the Nightmare and is a little confused.
But you have seen what he's capable of. This is not a runaway with a limp. He could never have fallen into the hands of those violent hoodlums.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Why did you pretend to run away when you had the power to deal with them?
The young man turns around, his face hidden in the shadows under his hood, and looks down at you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Are you trying to lure us somewhere? Where do you want to take us? Why are you doing this? Who are you?

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Sinners, you shouldn't be listening to their commands.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Don't get in the way.
The young man crushes the tiles beneath his feet, and at the same time, the pipes around you suddenly burst, and a wave of air pushes you against the mud wall. Is it a trap?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?!
Nightmare dumps the young man and rushes over to protect you, and before Hecate can reach you, another explosion comes from not far away. Sounds like the place you came from.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That direction is... where we got off?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Watch out. There's an ambush.
Several Molotov cocktails are thrown down, detonating the oil tanks set up behind you, and the fire quickly blocks your way back.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Is the Drifter Camp attacking DisCity authorities?

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: We would never dare... Drifter Camp dares not to disobey the executive officers' management.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: But sadly, the beloved exec was caught and killed in the crossfire of a gang conflict. We were too late to the rescue...
More people emerge from the slum's buildings in all directions, all wearing the same cloak as the young man, with firearms in their hands.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Worst case scenario... You will be considered enemies. In the event of an attack, communications will be jammed, and then you will be trapped in some mechanism and surrounded by hostile units.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It's the self-organized forces of the Drifter Camp. They don't use Mania weapons, but their combat capability is excellent.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Be especially careful when fighting on their turf.
